paragraphs.chinese:
这一集讲的是父母都想帮孩子，只不过他们经常搞不清楚，孩子真正需要的是哪一种帮助。

在 Dunphy 家，Luke 第二天就要交一个关于 Vincent van Gogh 的大作业，可他还完全没开始。Haley 也突然宣布，自己明天要为学校募捐活动带四十个纸杯蛋糕。Claire 接手做蛋糕，让 Phil 负责盯着 Luke。

Phil 不愿意像项目经理一样一直管。他觉得 Luke 只需要合适的工具和一点空间。问题是，Phil 本人比 Luke 还容易分心。每隔几分钟他就跑去修点家里的东西，Claire 越看越觉得这个作业肯定要完蛋。

Claire 对 Haley 则完全相反。她先教女儿怎么做蛋糕，之后 Haley 每做错一步，Claire 就马上伸手接管，最后几乎变成她自己把整份作业做完。

后来 Claire 去看 Luke，已经做好了看到一片灾难的准备。结果 Luke 居然自己做出一个挺有创意的展示板：一边讲 van Gogh 的人生，另一边讲他的画，整个思路还挺清楚。Claire 终于承认 Phil 让他自己来的做法是对的，也跟 Luke 道歉，之前没有给他足够的信任。然后她转身就让 Haley 自己把剩下的蛋糕做完。Haley 真做了，只不过味道难吃到全家得等她离开以后再一起吐掉。

与此同时，Mitchell 很期待去看流星雨，因为看星星一直是他和 Jay 两个人的固定活动。结果 Jay 把 Manny 也带上了。Manny 想让 Mitchell 像哥哥一样对自己，Jay 就告诉他，兄弟表达感情的方式就是互相取笑。

Manny 把这句话执行得特别认真。Mitchell 被臭鼬喷了一身以后，Jay 和 Manny 还不停拿他开玩笑，直到 Mitchell 真生气。Jay 这才说出真正的原因：Manny 没被邀请参加一个大派对，因为几个他以为是朋友的孩子觉得他“很怪”。Jay 根本不知道该怎么安慰，所以才把 Mitchell 带来，因为他觉得 Mitchell 可能懂。

后来 Mitchell 告诉 Manny，自己小时候也一直被人叫怪人。他说长大最奇怪的一点就是：小时候大家拼命害怕和别人不一样，可再过几年，所有人又开始抢着想变得不一样。这句话显然比 Jay 自己能说出来的东西更适合 Manny。

男生们出去以后，Cameron 带 Gloria 去吃饭，因为他很想跟她真正成为朋友。Cameron 太想表现了，明明 Gloria 已经警告他，他还是坚持点了一道辣到离谱的菜，最后几乎吃不下去。

等 Cameron 不再使劲“经营”这场晚餐，气氛反而自然起来。Gloria 开始跟他聊一些自己的事，到晚上结束时直接告诉他：两个人其实早就是朋友了。

Luke 是在 Claire 放手以后把事做成的，Manny 从真正理解自己的人那里得到安慰，而 Cameron 也是在停止用力之后，才终于和 Gloria 拉近了距离。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is about parents trying to help kids without always knowing what kind of help they actually need.

At the Dunphy house, Luke has a huge school project on Vincent van Gogh due the next day, and he hasn’t started. Haley also suddenly announces that she needs forty cupcakes for a fundraiser. Claire takes the cupcakes and tells Phil to stay on top of Luke.

Phil refuses to micromanage him. He says Luke just needs the right tools and a little space. The problem is that Phil is even easier to distract than Luke. Every few minutes he wanders away to fix something around the house, and Claire becomes more and more convinced that the project is going to be a disaster.

Claire handles Haley in the exact opposite way. She shows her how to make the cupcakes, then keeps stepping in every time Haley does something wrong until Claire is basically doing the whole job herself.

Later, Claire checks Luke’s room expecting nothing. Instead, she finds a creative display that he mostly built on his own. Luke split it into van Gogh’s life on one side and his paintings on the other, and it actually works. Claire admits Phil was right to give him room and tells Luke she should have trusted him more. Then she turns around and makes Haley finish her own cupcakes. Haley does, but they’re so bad that the family waits until she leaves before spitting them out.

Meanwhile, Mitchell is excited about a meteor shower because watching the stars has always been something he and Jay do together. Then Jay brings Manny along. Manny wants Mitchell to treat him like a brother, and Jay tells him brothers show affection by making fun of each other.

Manny takes that advice seriously. After Mitchell gets sprayed by a skunk, Jay and Manny keep teasing him until Mitchell finally gets angry. That’s when Jay tells him what’s really going on. Manny wasn’t invited to a party because some kids he thought were his friends think he’s weird. Jay doesn’t know how to talk to him about it, so he brought Mitchell along because he thought Mitchell might.

Mitchell later tells Manny that kids called him weird too. He says the strange thing about growing up is that everybody spends years terrified of being different, and then suddenly being different becomes something people want. Manny clearly needs to hear that from someone who actually lived it.

While the boys are out, Cameron takes Gloria to dinner because he wants them to be closer friends. He tries so hard to impress her that he orders an insanely spicy dish even after she warns him not to. He can barely eat it.

Once Cameron stops performing and just relaxes, the night gets easier. Gloria opens up to him, and by the end she tells him they’re already friends.

Luke succeeds when Claire backs off, Manny gets help from someone who understands him, and Cameron finally connects with Gloria once he stops forcing it.
